notes.title: Obscured Stories: The Resentment is now LIVE!
notes.content:
The wait is over — Obscured Stories: The Resentment is[b] officially out[/b]! 

As a solo developer I’m incredibly proud to share it with all of you that the very first installment of this serie is available! Thank you for your patience and support throughout the journey!

Your choices matter. With [b]five different endings[/b] to uncover, each decision you make will shape the story in its own unique way, giving you plenty of reasons to replay.

[b]And this is just the beginning.[/b]

The next standalone entry in the Obscured Stories series is already in development. It will continue exploring dark, emotional storytelling — but with a fresh narrative and characters, no prior experience needed.

I hope you enjoy it. Feedback is very much appreciated as I'll take that with me for my upcoming game!

Kind regards,

Armin

notes.title: 🎉 400+ Wishlists! A Huge Thank You! 🎉
notes.content:
I’m incredibly excited and grateful to announce that Obscured Stories: The Resentment has hit OVER 400 wishlists on Steam!

As a solo developer working on the first game in the 'Obscured Stories' series, it's amazing to see such interest from you guys, thanks! ːsteamhappyː
